leaders.name: Florida Man
leaders.passive: Once during your Turn, when your own card or attack ability damages a friendly Character and it survives, it gets +1 Power this Turn.
leaders.schemeText: Deal 4 damage to the opposing Leader and 2 damage to each opposing Character.

leaders.name: Washed-Up Rock Star
leaders.passive: After you play your second card during your Turn, if you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, draw a card.
leaders.schemeText: Draw 3 cards and Ready up to 2 spent Stash.

leaders.name: Birthday Party Magician
leaders.passive: Once during your Turn, when a friendly Character Returns to hand, Ready 1 spent Stash.
leaders.schemeText: Return up to two opposing Characters to their owners’ hands, then draw 2 cards.

leaders.name: Trash Baron
leaders.passive: The first Item you play during your Turn costs 1 less.
leaders.schemeText: Put an Item from your discard into play, then draw 2 cards.

leaders.name: HOA President
leaders.passive: The first time you Block each Turn, prevent 1 damage to that Blocker during that combat.
leaders.schemeText: Deal 8 damage to the opposing Leader.

leaders.name: Backyard Wrestler
leaders.passive: Once during your Turn after a friendly Character is Defeated, reveal your top card. If it is an Expendable Character costing no more than your Stash count, put it into play with Hothead. Otherwise put it into your hand.
leaders.schemeText: Put a Character costing 4 or less from your discard into play. It has Hothead this Turn.

leaders.name: Crazy Cat Lady
leaders.passive: Your deck may contain up to 10 Stray Cats. If you control at least 3 Cats, the first Cat you play during your Turn costs 1 less.
leaders.schemeText: Put three 1/1 Cat tokens into play, then draw 2 cards.

leaders.name: Mad Scientist
leaders.passive: After mulligans, put your top 5 cards into Ready Stash. You cannot Stash normally. At the start of your Turn, Ready up to 3 spent Stash. You get no temporary setup Stash.
leaders.schemeText: Ready all your Stash. You may set one Abomination’s Power or Guard to 6.
